drhp.business: Trejhara delivers integrated logistics solutions across freight forwarding (Ocean FCL/LCL, Air, Cross-Trade), warehousing and distribution, and third-party logistics (3PL), underpinned by its proprietary SCMProFit supply-chain management software. During FY26 it diversified into Trade Fairs & Exhibitions through the acquisition of an established exhibitions business, managing exhibitor logistics, venue delivery and end-to-end event execution alongside its core logistics operations.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Logistics demand is influenced by economic growth, consumer spending, business investment, interest rates, fuel prices, trade policies and geopolitical developments; slowdowns or trade disruptions could adversely affect volumes, costs and profitability.
- Geopolitical tensions and disruptions across critical trade corridors, notably the ongoing disruption around the Strait of Hormuz (carrying about one-fifth of global oil and gas supplies), can restrict shipping routes, raise fuel/freight costs and war-risk insurance premiums, and extend transit times; the Company's cross-border freight forwarding operations and Middle East footprint are directly exposed.
- The crisis in West Asia has forced large-scale rerouting of vessel traffic, extending transit times and tightening vessel/container availability, with war-risk surcharges and higher marine insurance premiums pushing up the cost of trade; the Company cannot be assured that diversification of trade lanes and carrier partnerships will fully offset further deterioration.
- Changes in customer sourcing strategies, freight costs and economic conditions may impact demand for outsourced supply chain and logistics services.
- Dependence on key customers may expose the Company to revenue and volume risks in the event of loss or reduction of business.
- Rapid technological developments require continuous investment in automation, digital platforms, analytics and cybersecurity to remain competitive.
- Attracting, developing and retaining skilled talent is important to sustaining operational and technology-led growth.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Consolidation of offerings and strengthening position in existing markets
- Pursuing new geographies through organic growth, acquisitions and strategic partnerships
- Extending further into the wider logistics ecosystem and allied sectors
- Deepening presence in the logistics sector while expanding service and technology capabilities
- Strengthening customer relationships and creating an integrated logistics platform
- Complementing core logistics focus with the Trade Fairs and Exhibitions segment
